name: Tapfiliate
label: Tapfiliate REST v1.6 — affiliates, clicks, conversions
description: Tapfiliate REST 1.6 at https://api.tapfiliate.com/1.6. Docs: https://tapfiliate.com/docs/rest/. conversion_create requires external_id plus click_id or referral_code. Auth header X-Api-Key. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: affiliate_create | click_create | conversion_create | program_list. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: firstname
schema.description: Affiliate first name. Required on affiliate_create.

schema.label: lastname
schema.description: Affiliate last name. Required on affiliate_create.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Affiliate email. Required on affiliate_create.

schema.label: referral_code
schema.description: Referral code on click_create (required) and conversion_create (when click_id omitted).

schema.label: asset_id
schema.description: program_list query asset_id to filter programs.

schema.label: company
schema.description: Affiliate company on affiliate_create.

schema.label: address
schema.description: Affiliate address object on affiliate_create (address, city, country, zipcode).

schema.label: source_id
schema.description: Optional source_id on click_create.

schema.label: referrer
schema.description: Referrer URL on click_create.

schema.label: click_id
schema.description: Existing click id on conversion_create. Alternative to referral_code.

schema.label: coupon
schema.description: Coupon code on conversion_create.

schema.label: external_id
schema.description: Your unique conversion id on conversion_create. Required. Used for idempotency. Example: order-1001.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Conversion amount on conversion_create. Example: 99.00.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO currency on conversion_create. Example: EUR.

schema.label: commission_type
schema.description: conversion_create commission_type. standard | first-promoter | recurring.

schema.label: customer_id
schema.description: Your customer id on conversion_create.

schema.label: meta_data
schema.description: conversion_create meta_data object.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: affiliate_create | click_create | conversion_create | program_list. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type header. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
